correctness.rationale: The Gaussian conditional mean yields an exact quartic maximization of F on a compact simplex and risk 1/3-2F. A rational witness and a strict degree-12 Bernstein positivity certificate exclude all boundary maximizers. The resultant and first-degree subresultant reduce every interior stationary point to an explicit sextic and rational second-coordinate formula. Descartes plus three exact sign-changing intervals exhaust positive roots; whole-interval rational Bernstein certificates exclude one feasible-x root because it violates x+y<1. The remaining unique root is feasible, hence the unique global optimum. Every algebraic certificate and exact risk comparator was reproduced by verify.py; numeric values are display only.
